edges.reason: onlyAdmin compares msg.sender against owner() and uriExtended to gate privileged functions.
uriExtended participates in the admin identity comparison.
owner() is compared with msg.sender inside onlyAdmin.
flipSaleState is guarded by the onlyAdmin modifier.
withdraw is guarded by the onlyAdmin modifier.
reserveTokens is guarded by the onlyAdmin modifier.
setMaxTokenSupply is guarded by the onlyAdmin modifier.
setNFTSalePrice is guarded by the onlyAdmin modifier.
airdrop is guarded by the onlyAdmin modifier.
updateMaxNFT is guarded by the onlyAdmin modifier.
calcStartingIndex is guarded by the onlyAdmin modifier.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock is guarded by the onlyAdmin modifier.
setBaseURI is guarded by the onlyAdmin modifier.
flipSaleState negates saleIsActive.
flipSaleState reads the current saleIsActive value.
withdraw executes the full-balance transfer.
attacker-influenced recipient address flows into the transfer.
cached contract balance is the amount transferred.
mint requires saleIsActive to be true.
NFT_PRICE is multiplied by the token count when validating msg.value.
mint reads NFT_PRICE for the price check.
mint enforces totalSupply + count <= MAX_SUPPLY.
MAX_SUPPLY is read in the mint supply check.
mint enforces count <= MAX_NFT_PURCHASE.
MAX_NFT_PURCHASE is read in the mint purchase check.
msg.sender determines who receives the minted tokens.
mint calls _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received on contract recipients before the loop finishes.
the ERC721 receiver callback can re-enter mint while it is still executing.
user-supplied mint quantity controls the mint loop.
airdrop reads _airdropNumber for the 125 cap check.
airdrop updates _airdropNumber after minting.
airdrop mints via _safeMint, triggering the receiver callback.
receiver callback can re-enter airdrop before the counter is updated.
admin-supplied user address receives airdropped tokens.
admin-supplied count drives the airdrop loop.
reserveTokens sets startingIndexBlock to block.number when it is zero.
reserveTokens reads startingIndexBlock for the zero check.
reserveTokens mints via _safeMint, triggering the receiver callback.
receiver callback can re-enter reserveTokens before minting completes.
num controls the reserve minting loop bound.
cached totalSupply is used to derive new token ids.
reserveTokens mints the reserved tokens to msg.sender.
calcStartingIndex writes the derived startingIndex.
calcStartingIndex takes the blockhash modulo MAX_SUPPLY.
calcStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock as the randomness seed reference.
calcStartingIndex relies on blockhash/block.number, influenced by block producers (weak randomness).
miner-influenceable blockhash value determines the final startingIndex.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock overwrites startingIndexBlock with block.number.
setMaxTokenSupply writes MAX_SUPPLY.
setMaxTokenSupply validates against MAX_SUPPLY_LIMIT.
maxSupply argument is the new MAX_SUPPLY value.
setNFTSalePrice writes NFT_PRICE.
newNFTPrice argument is the new NFT_PRICE value.
updateMaxNFT writes MAX_NFT_PURCHASE.
updateMaxNFT validates the new cap against MAX_SUPPLY.
_maxNFT argument is the new purchase cap.
setBaseURI writes _baseURIExtended.
baseURI_ argument is the new base URI.
_baseURI reads _baseURIExtended.
_baseURIExtended is returned by _baseURI.
tokenURI reads the base URI via _baseURI.
tokenURI reads the per-token URI override.
tokenId selects the token metadata to return.
tokenURI internally calls _baseURI to build the metadata string.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is the withdraw parameter that flows directly into the unsafe transfer operation.
balance is the local holding the amount sent by the unsafe transfer in withdraw.
num is the loop bound parameter of reserveTokens.
supply is a local derived from totalSupply inside reserveTokens.
maxSupply is the sole parameter written to MAX_SUPPLY.
newNFTPrice is the sole parameter written to NFT_PRICE.
user is the beneficiary parameter of the airdrop mint loop.
number is the loop count parameter of airdrop.
numberOfTokensMax5 is the quantity parameter driving the mint loop.
_maxNFT is the parameter written to MAX_NFT_PURCHASE.
baseURI_ is the parameter written to _baseURIExtended.
tokenId is the lookup parameter of tokenURI.
